evidence.detail: The class owns and renders the exact gameframe sprite families: HP/prayer/run/spec orbs, gameframe chat buttons and redstones, sidebar icons, adventure/event/promo orbs, bank/equipment toggles, heal/refill/boss/XP/hit toggles and side-panel arrows.

Client stores one rs/i/b instance and invokes it from the central frame/render paths; the class also updates gameframe dimensions/visibility state and draws through Graphics2D plus rs/l/F sprite primitives.
The class directly owns the 14-entry rs/i/b$a sidebar-tab enum and uses tab index/state together with interface state when drawing and switching the side panel.
Canonical lexical baseline ordering places rs/i/a at CLIENT_CLASS_000296, rs/i/b at CLIENT_CLASS_000297 and rs/i/b$a at CLIENT_CLASS_000298.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the client gameframe/chrome renderer. No historical original source identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: The enum constants survive verbatim as ATTACK, STATS, QUEST, INVENTORY, EQUIPMENT, PRAYER, MAGIC, CLAN, FRIENDS, IGNORE, LOGOUT, OPTIONS, EMOTES and MUSIC.
Each enum entry stores one logical tab index plus rendering/layout metadata, and a static lookup returns the enum entry for a supplied tab index.
The only enclosing subsystem is rs/i/b GameFrameRenderer, which owns sidebar icon/redstone assets and tab-selection state.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 descriptive identity for the 14 gameframe sidebar tabs.
